mira: Quick sync, final green-room ops for Thurs webinar 11am PT. Need a concise fallback and who executes it.

alex: I can flip routes. Provide exact command and confirm warm-standby config.

jamal: I'll make two cue cards: 1) brief pause message, 2) condensed-answer line. Drop PDF to #marketing-assets.

sara: Ops will run a full preflight at 10:20 PT and prime KV cache. Warm-standby settings: min_instances=1, quantized=true, region=us-west-2.

ops-bot: note: recording enabled. Zoom link set for 2026-03-26T18:00:00Z.

kevin: On-call for the slot. Rollback rule: if p50 latency > 3s for 120s, switch to cached condensed responses and page eng-oncall.

alex: Route flip command (sandbox): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"route":"demo","model":"gpt-mini-1"}'`

mira: Speaker one-liner for condensed answers: "We're showing shorter examples to keep things responsive; full examples in follow-up email."

sara: Lead routing rule: attendees > 500 -> `webinar-high` SDR queue, else `webinar-regular`. I'll add to post-demo workflow.

mira: Green-room 9:50 PT. Thanks, uploading final assets shortly.
